Letter of Inquiry

Question. We ask who posts about municipal council politics on the forum platform Stadtgespräch
and how this discussion relates to the council calendar.

Data. We will use all public posts in the local-politics boards of the platform from 2019 to
2023, obtained through the export interface.

Planned analyses. (1) The concentration of posting across accounts. (2) The timing of posts
relative to council meetings. (3) The share of uncivil posts, coded with a validated
classifier. (4) A comparison of all three quantities with a second regional platform.

Output. A baseline description of local political discussion with numbers that others can
cite, and a table of key values per municipality size class.
